 Presented by Colts announce 7 inactive players for Week 9 game against Dallas Cowboys
 Justin Walley (knee) and Akeem Davis-Gaither (knee) were previously ruled out.
 Nov 08, 2026 at 11:32 AM Abby Halpin Contributing Writer
 Copied! 
 The Colts ruled out seven players for Week 9's game at Lucas Oil Stadium against the Dallas Cowboys:
 TE Pharaoh Brown
 LB Akeem Davis-Gaither
 S AJ Haulcy
 T Charlie Heck
 QB Riley Leonard (emergency 3rd QB)
 TE Will Mallory
 CB Justin Walley
 The Colts had previously ruled out Walley (knee) and Davis-Gaither (knee) on Friday. Haulcy (ankle) was ruled out Saturday morning after being listed as questionable Friday.
 Tackle Jalen Travis, who was listed as questionable Friday with thumb and hamstring injuries, is active.
